comment: Capability-lint URL allowlist. An entry is either a bare host (matches that exact host) or host/path-prefix (matches URLs on that host whose path starts with /path-prefix/). Grown only by PR to this file. Per-entry rationale for non-obvious entries lives in entry_notes below (the validator reads only `allowed`).

entry_notes.github.com/orgs/SummerEngine: Org-listing URL form (github.com/orgs/SummerEngine/...) of the already-allowed SummerEngine GitHub org.
entry_notes.agentskills.io: The open Agent Skills specification, which Summer adopts as its skill format; read-only spec documentation.
entry_notes.polyhaven.com: First-party HDRI/asset integration target (summer_import_hdri allowlists it); documentation links are legitimate.
entry_notes.elevenlabs.io: Summer's voice provider (summer_generate_audio); documentation links are legitimate.
